Use it to see the legal pages rendered while building and testing --
linking them from a footer, checking they read well, screenshotting a
demo -- without needing a lawyer or your registered company details yet.
Every value is deliberately, obviously fake. Email addresses use the
reserved .invalid domain (RFC 2606), which can never be registered, so a
stray form or script cannot mail a real person by accident.
The publish gate (--check) ALWAYS fails on this file, whatever it
contains, so these values cannot become your live policy by being left
in place. Fill company.json for that.
